name: glb-designer-stage3c
description: Asset Studio Stage 3c — template-first flows in the GLB Asset Designer (Pro, glbDesigner on). Open the Templates section, tap 'Dining table' to arm it (a compact parametric step opens with the template's ergonomic sliders + a LIVE preview), widen it via the Width slider, then 'Use template' — it flattens into the (empty) spec as a single named 'Dining table' Group. Then tap 'Bookshelf', 'Use template' again — because the spec is now non-empty it inserts ALONGSIDE (offset on +X), so both pieces are present as two Group rows. Finally Save and assert the persisted assetSpec envelope embeds BOTH template groups: the dining table at identity (it replaced the empty spec) with its tabletop top at the height param, and the bookshelf carrying a positive X offset. Screenshots the template picker with sliders + live preview, the inserted dining table, and table + bookshelf together.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); })()

steps.name: expand-templates
steps.comment: Expand the collapsed Templates section (progressive-disclosure Disclosure) before interacting.

steps.name: arm-dining-template
steps.comment: Tap the Dining table template — the picker opens its parametric step (sliders + live preview).

steps.name: assert-dining-armed
steps.comment: The parametric step shows the template's ergonomic Width slider (with unit + range + hint) and Use/Cancel actions.
steps.eval: (function(){ if (!document.querySelector('.glb-designer input[aria-label="Dining table Width"]')) throw new Error('Dining table Width slider missing — template did not arm'); if (!document.querySelector('.glb-designer button[aria-label="Use Dining table template"]')) throw new Error('Use template action missing'); })()

steps.name: widen-dining
steps.comment: Drag the Width slider to 2.0 m — the live preview updates before anything is committed.
steps.eval: (function(){ const inp = document.querySelector('.glb-designer input[aria-label="Dining table Width"]'); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(inp), 'value').set; setter.call(inp, '2'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); })()

steps.name: use-dining
steps.comment: Insert the flattened dining table. The empty spec is REPLACED; the new 'Dining table' group is selected.

steps.name: assert-dining-group
steps.comment: One 'Dining table' group row appears in the layers tree and it's selected (its Edit-group panel is up).
steps.eval: (function(){ const names = [...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer .lyr-nm')].map(n => (n.textContent||'').trim()); const n = names.filter(t => t === 'Dining table').length; if (n !== 1) throw new Error('expected 1 Dining table group row, got ' + n); if (!document.querySelector('.glb-designer input[aria-label="group position X"]')) throw new Error('inserted group not selected (Edit-group fields missing)'); })()

steps.name: expand-templates-2
steps.comment: Expand the collapsed Templates section (progressive-disclosure Disclosure) before interacting.

steps.name: arm-bookshelf-template
steps.comment: Tap the Bookshelf template (DOM-click by aria-label — robust to any scroll).
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = document.querySelector('.glb-designer button[aria-label="Start from Bookshelf template"]'); if (!btn) throw new Error('Bookshelf template button not found'); btn.scrollIntoView(); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-bookshelf-armed
steps.eval: (function(){ if (!document.querySelector('.glb-designer button[aria-label="Use Bookshelf template"]')) throw new Error('Bookshelf template did not arm'); })()

steps.name: use-bookshelf
steps.comment: Insert alongside — the spec is non-empty, so the bookshelf lands offset on +X (no confirm).
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = document.querySelector('.glb-designer button[aria-label="Use Bookshelf template"]'); btn.scrollIntoView(); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-both-present
steps.comment: Two Group rows now: 'Dining table' + 'Bookshelf' — both pieces are in the spec.
steps.eval: (function(){ const names = [...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer .lyr-nm')].map(n => (n.textContent||'').trim()); if (names.filter(t => t === 'Dining table').length !== 1) throw new Error('Dining table group missing after inserting bookshelf'); if (names.filter(t => t === 'Bookshelf').length !== 1) throw new Error('Bookshelf group missing'); })()

steps.name: set-asset-name
steps.eval: (function(){ const inp = document.querySelector('.glb-designer input[aria-label="Asset name"]'); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(inp), 'value').set; setter.call(inp, 'Stage3c Templates'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); })()

steps.name: click-save
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.glb-designer button')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Save asset' && !b.disabled); if (!btn) throw new Error('Save asset button not found or disabled'); btn.scrollIntoView(); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-saved-templates
steps.comment: End-to-end proof: the saved assetSpec is the shared asset envelope and embeds BOTH template groups — the dining table at identity (replaced the empty spec) with its tabletop top at the 0.75 m height param, and the bookshelf offset on +X (inserted alongside). Templates round-trip as editable PartGroups and restore intact.

waitFor.store: state.userFurniture.length > window.__glbBaseline && state.userFurniture.some(d => d.name === 'Stage3c Templates' && typeof d.assetSpec === 'string' && d.assetSpec.includes('"kind":"asset"') && (() => { try { const env = JSON.parse(d.assetSpec); const s = env.payload; const groups = s.partGroups || []; const dining = groups.filter(g => g.name === 'Dining table'); const shelf = groups.filter(g => g.name === 'Bookshelf'); if (groups.length !== 2 || dining.length !== 1 || shelf.length !== 1) return false; if (dining[0].position) return false; if (!shelf[0].position || !(shelf[0].position[0] > 0)) return false; const dIds = new Set(dining[0].partIds); let topY = -Infinity; let minX = Infinity; let maxX = -Infinity; for (const p of s.parts) { if (!dIds.has(p.id)) continue; topY = Math.max(topY, p.position[1] + p.size[1] / 2); minX = Math.min(minX, p.position[0] - p.size[0] / 2); maxX = Math.max(maxX, p.position[0] + p.size[0] / 2); } return Math.abs(topY - 0.75) < 0.03 && Math.abs((maxX - minX) - 2.0) < 0.05; } catch { return false } })())

steps.failMessage: saved assetSpec should embed a 'Dining table' group (identity, tabletop top 0.75 m, width 2.0 m) + a 'Bookshelf' group offset on +X
